title: The 5 Highest Mountains on Earth, Ranked (All in Asia)

scenes.text: The five highest mountains on Earth are all in Asia. Nothing anywhere else comes close.

scenes.label: Makalu · 8,485 m
scenes.text: Number five: Makalu. Eight thousand four hundred eighty-five meters, first climbed by a French team in 1955.

scenes.label: Lhotse · 8,516 m
scenes.text: Number four: Lhotse. Eight thousand five hundred sixteen meters, first climbed in 1956 by a Swiss team.

scenes.label: Kangchenjunga · 8,586 m
scenes.text: Number three: Kangchenjunga. Eight thousand five hundred eighty-six meters, first climbed in 1955.

scenes.label: K2 · 8,611 m
scenes.text: Number two: K2. Eight thousand six hundred eleven meters, first climbed in 1954 by an Italian team.

scenes.label: Everest · 8,849 m
scenes.text: Number one: Mount Everest. About eight thousand eight hundred forty-nine meters above sea level, first climbed in 1953.

description:
The five highest mountains on Earth, measured by elevation above sea level.
Number one, Mount Everest, stands about 8,849 meters high, and all five are in Asia.
Which peak would you climb?
first_comment: Which mountain would you climb first, and what should we rank next?
